name: whatsapp-mcp
description: WhatsApp Business (messaging): me, send, mark_read. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_whatsapp_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_whatsapp_access_token.description: System user access token or business token of the WhatsApp Business Account (whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management), sent as `Authorization: Bearer` as in every Cloud API example (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/messages/text-messages).

platform_mcp_whatsapp_phone_number_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
platform_mcp_whatsapp_phone_number_id.description: WhatsApp business phone number ID (not the phone number itself, e.g. 106540352242922; GET /<WABA_ID>/phone_numbers lists them). Every call goes to /<phone_number_id>/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /{phone_number_id}?fields=id,display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,status: the business phone number the token sends from.

tools.name: send
tools.description: POST /{phone_number_id}/messages {messaging_product: whatsapp, recipient_type: individual, to, type: text, text: {body}} answers {contacts[{input, wa_id}], messages[{id: wamid...}]}. `to` is the user's phone number (e.g. +16505551234); body up to 4096 characters. Free-form text only reaches users inside the 24-hour customer service window; outside it only approved template messages can be sent (not mapped). `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: POST /{phone_number_id}/messages {messaging_product: whatsapp, status: read, message_id} answers {success: true}. `message_id` (the wamid from the incoming-message webhook) is REQUIRED by WhatsApp; 'When you mark a message as read, the API also marks earlier messages in the conversation as read'; within 30 days of receipt. `thread_id` is not used.
